source_title: Bel-Mac Roofing and Seashore Construction Join Forces to Expand Roofing and Building Envelope Services Across Northwest Florida
source_excerpt:
Strategic investment from ACACIA Exterior Building Group brings two established local businesses together under the Bel-Mac name, with expanded capabilities and a continued commitment to the communities they serve.
SANTA ROSA BEACH, Fla. , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Bel-Mac Roofing and Seashore Construction today announced that they are joining forces under the Bel-Mac name, bringing together decades of local experience in roofing, waterproofing, restoration and exterior construction across Northwest Florida and the greater Gulf Coast.
The combination is supported by a strategic investment from ACACIA Exterior Building Group, which partners with established roofing and exterior building businesses to invest in their people, strengthen their operations and support long-term growth. Existing local leadership will remain in place, and customers will continue to work with the teams they know.
Founded in 1995, Bel-Mac has built its reputation on roofing expertise and longstanding customer relationships. Seashore Construction, founded in 2005, brings complementary experience in waterproofing, concrete repair, exterior restoration and construction. Together, the companies will help customers address more of their buildings' needs through one coordinated team.
"Bel-Mac is a family business in more ways than one, and it has been a staple of this community since 1995. What our team does every day to support the places where we live, work and play is what keeps me excited. Coming together with Seashore is something I've looked forward to for a long time, and I know what it will mean for our partners in the community. I'm looking forward to continuing to support the place we all call home," said Travis Bell.
The combined Bel-Mac will offer roofing solutions; waterproofing and coatings; concrete repair and restoration; exterior cladding and siding; structural and framing solutions; and building envelope rehabilitation and exterior construction.
For property owners and managers, condominium associations, developers, and general contractors, the combination brings related services together under one organization. Customers will have access to additional expertise and resources, whether planning routine maintenance, addressing repairs or undertaking a larger renovation or restoration project.
"Bringing Seashore Construction and Bel-Mac together represents an exciting new chapter for both companies. By combining our experience and expertise in commercial roofing and building envelope restoration with the resources and support of our new platform, we are building a stronger, more collaborative team that can deliver comprehensive solutions and exceptional service to our customers," said Alex R. Kish.
For Cagen Williams, Chief Executive Officer of ACACIA Exterior Building Group, the partnership also carries personal significance. Williams lived in Northwest Florida for more than 30 years before relocating to the Washington, D.C., area.
"Northwest Florida is home to me. I know these communities and understand what these companies have meant to the people they serve," said Williams. "Having the opportunity to invest in two strong local businesses and the people behind them is incredibly meaningful. Our goal is to give this team the resources to grow while protecting the relationships, reputation and local roots that made both companies successful."
ACACIA's investment will help the combined company strengthen operations, invest in its workforce and pursue larger and more complex projects. Moving forward under the Bel-Mac name, the organization will build on the contributions of both companies and their shared commitment to the communities they call home.
Founded in 1995, Bel-Mac provides roofing and building envelope solutions throughout Northwest Florida and the Gulf Coast. Through its combination with Seashore Construction, founded in 2005, the company brings together decades of local experience in roofing, waterproofing and coatings, concrete repair and restoration, exterior cladding and siding, structural and framing solutions, and related exterior construction services.
ACACIA Exterior Building Group, based in Alexandria, Virginia, partners with and invests in established roofing and exterior building businesses. ACACIA supports long-term growth through investment in people, shared resources and operational capabilities, while preserving the local leadership, identity and customer relationships that have made its partner companies successful.
